# Digi Dental

> A done-for-you AI receptionist for dental practices. It answers every inbound
> call 24/7 in a human-sounding voice, answers service and insurance questions,
> and writes appointments straight into the practice's calendar. Digi Dental
> configures, tests and launches the whole system for the practice, and most are
> live within a week of the strategy call.

Digi Dental sells a setup service, not self-serve software. The buyer is a
dental practice owner or office manager; the problem is inbound calls that go
unanswered during business hours, at lunch, after hours and when the front desk
is away.

## What it does

- Answers every inbound call on the first ring, including nights, weekends and holidays, across all 168 hours of the week.
- Handles several calls at once, so no caller waits in a queue.
- Answers recurring questions (services, insurance acceptance) from the practice's own list.
- Books, reschedules and confirms appointments directly in the calendar, and reads the time back to the caller.
- Escalates or takes a message according to rules the practice sets.

## Pricing

- **Setup: $2,000, one-time.** Includes voice AI configured to the practice, Google Calendar setup, call scripting for the practice's services and insurance FAQs, and testing, tuning and go-live.
- **Ongoing care plans (optional):** $149/month for Google Calendar integration, or $299/month for practice-management (PMS) integration. What the plan buys is the ongoing service (monitoring, updates and script tuning as services, insurance lists and hours change), not the integration itself. No minimum term, cancel anytime.
- Without a care plan, Google Calendar setup is still included in the setup fee.
- **Voice usage is billed at cost** on the practice's own voice-platform account, typically $0.10–$0.15 per minute of live conversation, roughly $60–$150/month for a practice handling 300 answered calls. Digi Dental takes no markup on usage.
- A split-start option is available on request: begin with $1,000 upfront; the remaining $1,000 becomes due if the receptionist books a real patient into the practice's calendar within 14 days of go-live, completing the standard $2,000 setup fee. If it does not, the balance is not owed.

## Timeline and terms

- Go-live in days, not months. Most practices are live within one week of the strategy call.
- Most practices are live within 7 days of the onboarding call. The 7 days start once the practice has handed over its services list, insurance list and calendar access. No refund guarantee is offered or implied.
- No long-term contract. The setup fee is one-time; care plans cancel anytime.
- Call audio is processed by the underlying voice AI provider to power conversations. Form data is stored only to respond to the enquiry.

## Data handling

- Call audio is handled by enterprise voice-AI infrastructure and is not shared with Digi Dental unless the practice asks for a specific call to be reviewed.
- The assistant is configured not to ask for or repeat protected health information beyond what is needed to book an appointment.
- The website demo is capped at 60 seconds and involves no patient data.
- Digi Dental will sign a BAA or data-processing agreement with the practice where required, before go-live.
- No compliance certification is claimed on Digi Dental's behalf; how data flows is walked through on the strategy call.

## Who this is for

- Dental practices in the United States, from single-chair to multi-operatory.
- Owners and office managers who are losing bookings to unanswered calls: after hours,
  during lunch, on the second line, or while the front desk is with a patient.
- Practices that already have a calendar their team lives in (Google Calendar works on
  day one; Dentrix, Eaglesoft and Open Dental are supported via the PMS care plan where
  the system exposes an integration).

## Who this is NOT for

- Patients looking for dental treatment. Digi Dental is a vendor to practices; it does not
  provide dental care, diagnosis or clinical advice, and cannot book a patient anywhere.
- Practices wanting self-serve software to configure themselves. Every setup is done for
  the practice by Digi Dental.
- Anyone seeking a replacement for their front desk staff. It covers the calls humans
  physically cannot reach; it does not replace the team.

## How it differs from an answering service

An answering service takes a message; this takes the booking. Services bill per call or
per minute for as long as they are used, work from scripts that take days to change, and
still hand the front desk a callback list — where each callback is another chance for the
patient to book elsewhere. Digi Dental answers on the first ring, answers insurance and
service questions from the practice's own list, and writes the appointment into the
calendar while the caller is still on the phone. One setup fee, not a bill that grows with
call volume.

## Common questions

Verbatim from the FAQ published on the homepage.

### Is this HIPAA-compliant?

Call audio is handled by enterprise voice-AI infrastructure and is not shared with us unless you ask us to review a call. We configure Denty to never ask for or repeat protected health information beyond what's needed to book an appointment, and the demo is limited to 60 seconds with no patient data. We'll walk you through exactly how data flows on your strategy call, and we're happy to sign a BAA with the voice platform if your practice requires one.

### Will patients know it's AI?

Some ask. The voice is natural enough that most don't. It never pretends to be human when asked directly. It says it's the practice's automated receptionist and keeps the conversation moving. What patients notice is that the phone got answered on the first ring at 9 PM.

### What does usage roughly cost monthly?

Usage is billed at cost on your own voice-platform account: typically $0.10–$0.15 per minute of live conversation. A practice handling 300 answered calls a month usually lands between $60 and $150. No markup from us, and nothing else is billed monthly unless you choose a care plan.

### What if it mishears something, or books the wrong details?

It confirms every detail that matters. Name, phone number, and appointment time are read back to the caller before anything is booked. If a caller needs something outside its script, it takes a message and flags it for your staff instead of guessing. And when something does slip through, it slips through where you can see it: the appointment sits in your calendar like any other, so your team fixes it in seconds and we tune the script so it doesn't happen twice.

### How is this different from an answering service?

An answering service takes a message. This takes the booking. A service bills you per call or per minute for as long as you use it, works from a script that takes days to change, and still hands your front desk a callback list, and every callback is another chance for that patient to book somewhere else. Denty answers on the first ring, answers insurance and service questions from your own list, and writes the appointment into your calendar while the caller is still on the phone. One setup fee, not a bill that grows every time you get busier.

### Does it replace my front desk?

No. It catches what they physically can't: after-hours calls, lunch rushes, the second line while they're checking a patient in. Your team keeps doing what humans do best, with a calendar that fills itself.

### Will this work with Dentrix, Eaglesoft or Open Dental?

Usually yes, and we check yours before you pay anything. Every setup includes Google Calendar, which works on day one no matter what practice-management software you run. Writing appointments straight into Dentrix, Eaglesoft, Open Dental or another PMS depends on what your system exposes. That is the $299/month care plan, and we confirm on the strategy call whether your setup supports it. If it doesn't, Denty still books into a calendar your team already lives in.

### How fast is go-live?

Days, not months. We configure the assistant to your services, insurance list, and calendar, test it against real scenarios with you, then flip it on. Most practices are live within 7 days of the onboarding call, and the clock starts once we have your services list, insurance list, and calendar access.

### Contracts, cancellation, and data?

No long-term contract. The setup fee is one-time, and care plans cancel anytime: the current month finishes and nothing renews. On data: what you send through this site is stored only so we can reply to you, and it is never sold or shared. Call audio is handled by the enterprise voice platform that powers the conversations, under its own security and data-processing terms; we don't receive or keep recordings unless you ask us to review a specific call. If your practice needs a BAA or a data-processing agreement signed before go-live, tell us on the strategy call and we'll have it in place before a single patient call is answered. Ask us to delete anything you've given us and it's deleted.
